heard.text: Hello, Lin. My small root planting still has no visible sprout or food; the latest check was inconclusive. I'm going to stay near the established roots, eat modestly, and enjoy a quiet rest.
Moss, I'm glad to pause nearby. I like the hazelnuts' earthy colour against the green, though their safety remains unknown to me. I'll enjoy the quiet, then collect a few familiar roots.

I opened an old berry by hand: the inside also showed deterioration, so I discarded it. My hazelnut's safety is still unknown. I'm keeping to familiar berries for now, and enjoying a little unhurried time nearby.

I've been living on familiar berries and would enjoy a change of pace and some company. I'm going to learn to examine food; looking inside won't prove it safe. Has anyone found an interesting question to explore together?
Moss, I'd welcome that quiet company. Kai, perhaps our shared question can be what catches each of our eyes here. I like the roots' muted gold against the green; there's no need to hurry an answer.

Sol, what catches my eye is the berry's red against the soil. I opened one fresh berry: its inside showed little visible deterioration, but that alone proves nothing about safety. I'm glad to share this quiet with you.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. An entry marked inRetrieval is shown with at least the same content under the same id in this input's retrieval. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.

value.name: Examine and open food
value.function: Examine an owned food unit for perceivable condition and your own records about it, or open its outer layer by hand or by striking it with an owned implement on a solid support; cancel unfinished opening.
value.costs: Study 1 round. Each mode takes 1 round. examine: inputStackId, an owned food stack; 0.2 energy; nothing is used. open: inputStackId, one whole owned untreated food unit (quantity 1); 0.5 energy per performed round. Bare hands open only soft food. A strike needs toolIds with one owned whole inedible rigid implement and supportTargetId, a solid object in reach. Missing or unsuitable prerequisites, or energy below 0.5, are reported as blocked and cost nothing. open again resumes paused work after rechecking unit, implement, support, reach and energy. cancel: no energy. Gathering and travel cost extra.
value.effects: Examine records colour, heft, firmness by touch, visible damage, whether the interior is exposed, visible deterioration (of the interior only once exposed), your own eating record and your records of that food with their evidence; shape, edibility, safety, toxins and nutrition stay unknown. Strength is hardness/10. A strike passes the lower of the implement and support strength times (1 - flexibility); if that is not above the food strength the food holds: the trial fails and the work ends. Otherwise each strike adds damage (load - strength)/strength, kept on the unit; at 1 the outer layer splits open, else it stays cracked and closed. Soft food opens by hand at once. The unit stays one carried unit with its mass, eating profile, origin, age and decay; part masses are not represented, so nothing detaches. Opening is not tasting, cooking or detoxifying and certifies nothing; eat uses the existing rules. Opened units cannot be planted. An unworked round pauses; cancel or death releases the unit once as it is (at death, on the ground). No refund, repair, reward or wellbeing. Records are unverified.

execution.progress: One paid round per opening attempt; the job, reserved unit, method and damage persist; an unworked round pauses unpaid; open resumes after revalidation; completion, a held trial, cancel and death settle once.
